title: Advantech ADAM-4017+ 8-Channel Analog Input Module
description: Baseline model for the Advantech ADAM-4017+ 8-channel differential analog input module (mV, V and mA inputs) read over RS-485 Modbus RTU; it applies to modules that report module name words 0x4017 and 0x5000 in holding registers 40211 and 40212. The module ships with the ADAM ASCII protocol and must be switched to Modbus first (ADAM-4000 Series User Manual Ed. 9, Appendix H.1, PDF page 290). Register map: Appendix G.1, table 3 'ADAM-4017+ 8-channel Analog Input Module', PDF page 277 (printed page 265): 4X addresses, one 16-bit register each, converted to zero-based addresses (40001 is address 0). The manual does not state the encoding of the current values (signedness and scaling follow the channel's input range and data format), so each channel is exposed as a raw word and the user decodes it with the range the channel is set to. The manual lists the function code only as the 4X data table, which this model reads as holding registers. Left out: the per-channel type codes and the channel enable word, which are configuration, and the writes the manual marks R/W.

AI0_RAW.description: Raw current value of analog input channel 0, read only. Holding register 40001 (zero-based address 0), one 16-bit word; ADAM-4017+ table of Appendix G.1, PDF page 277 of the ADAM-4000 Series User Manual Ed. 9. The manual does not state the encoding: it depends on the channel's input range and data format, so decode it with the range configured for the channel.
